facts.fact: Weather Impact states that a GCA-funded project built a Google Earth Engine web platform giving access to satellite data and agricultural indices, trained 12 Gambian government departments from April 2024, and aimed to transfer the services to the Department of Water Resources.
facts.system: Gambia Google Earth Engine DCAS platform

systems.system: Digital Farming platform (Google Earth Engine app)

GMB.note: The platform is a project web portal; no public body is stated to publish downloadable datasets or a licence.
